_doc: ALARM-backing metric-filters (monitoring plan 阶段3). These are DEDICATED, DENSE
(defaultValue:0) filters — one per card_health kind we alarm on — SEPARATE from the sparse
dimensioned CardHealth metric in a-class-metrics.json (which is for the dashboard breakdown).
WHY a separate dense filter per kind instead of alarming on the dimensioned CardHealth:
the dimensioned metric is SPARSE (a kind's stream only gets points when that kind fires), so a
rate/threshold alarm on it sits in INSUFFICIENT_DATA between events and can't judge stably. A
dedicated filter with defaultValue:0 emits 0 on every non-matching gateway log line → the metric
is DENSE → the alarm evaluates stably (plan 阶段3 澄清).
Same contract + same applier as a-class-metrics.json: apply with
These have NO dimensions (so defaultValue:0 is legal) and metricValue 1 (a count).
toolcall_leak_detected (竞泄复发) and finalize_failed (冻卡) are the two mandatory health alarms.

metrics.name: CardHealthToolcallLeak
metrics.purpose: 竞泄复发（agent 原始 <invoke> XML 泄漏到卡片）— 出现即异常，稠密化以便稳定告警

metrics.name: CardHealthFinalizeFailed
metrics.purpose: 冻卡（finalize 失败，卡片停在分析中）— 出现即异常，稠密化以便稳定告警

metrics.name: GatewayHeartbeat
metrics.purpose: 网关存活心跳：gateway 每 60s 发一次（与流量无关）。这是 LogPipelineStalled 存活告警的兜底 metric——它在正常运行中天然非零（即使空闲），所以 metric 缺失=管道断（CloudWatch agent 挂/网关静默），能区分『活着但空闲』与『死了』。绝不能用流量驱动的 QuestionsReceived 判活（空闲夜晚=0 会误判成死）。

metrics.name: AnswerFailedTotal
metrics.purpose: 答案失败总数（不分 reason）：a-class 的 AnswerFailed 按 reason 维度拆分→稀疏，无法稳定做突增告警。这条无维度、稠密化（defaultValue:0）的总数 metric 专供 AnswerFailedBurst 告警——失败率突增时稳定触发。reason 拆分仍看 a-class 维度 metric/看板。
